description.narrative: The Manjang Biosphere reserve project strategized to adopt the internationally recognized Man and the Biosphere program approach where the MFBR nominated, registered and managed by collaborative effort of the government and community in the area. These reserves promote conservation solutions and work to preserve biodiversity through a focus on sustainability. Biospheres aim to reconcile environmental conservation with economic development through scientific research and community education. Biospheres lead to harmonic co-existence of local communities with culture and local surrounding and provide opportunities for conserving nature through the sustainable use of natural resources. Biospheres are created with the goal of accomplishing three basic functions: Conservation function Biosphere reserves aim to contribute to the preservation of landscapes, ecosystems, species and genetic variation Development function Biosphere reserves aim to foster economic development which is socio-culturally and ecologically sustainable Logistic function Provide support for research, monitoring, education and information exchange related to local, national and global issues of conservation and development
Det övergripande målet med projektet är lokalsamhällets hållbara utveckling och främjandet av den lokala biologiska och kulturella mångfalden i Majang zonen i Gambella regionen.
The overall objective of the project is improved sustainable community development and local bio-cultural diversity in Majang zone in Gambella region.

- Strengthened management of natural resources and ecosystems services - Improved capacity among public institutions and other actors at national and local level to contribute to environmental sustainability, increased resilience to environmental impact, climate change and natural disasters, and reduced climate change. - Increased production of and improved access to renewable energy
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
